title: skibidi pack
description: overlays the word skibidi on every single block texture
body: Overlays the word "skibidi" on every single texture. Should work on every Minecraft version, if it doesn't join the discord server on my profile to notify me about it. I don't know what else to write here... It's just a skibidi pack. Requested by thttyytt (aka F4ded_)
